description: Single compact fantasy RPG skill icon, crisp 16-bit pixel art, bold clean dark outline, 3 shades per color, simple readable silhouette, centered with 5 pixel empty margin, no frame, no letters, transparent background. A short diagonal silver dagger with a deep purple hilt at upper right and blade tip down-left. Thick bright toxic green venom coats the blade and TWO large green poison drops fall below its tip. Make the dagger and green dripping venom equally clear. Simple chunky pixels, no shield, no text.
